question: For weekly-sales data, I need an analysis of our sales performance around mid-June for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020. Specifically, calculate the percentage change in sales between the four weeks leading up to June 15 and the four weeks following June 15 for each year.
sql:
-- Calculate total sales for before and after periods, then percentage change
WITH weekly_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(week_date, '/', 2) AS INTEGER) as month_num,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(week_date, '/', 3) AS INTEGER) as year_short,
    TRY_CAST('20' || SPLIT_PART(week_date, '/', 3) AS INTEGER) as year,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(week_date, '/', 1) AS INTEGER) as day,
    SUM(sales) as total_sales
  FROM weekly_sales
  GROUP BY week_date
),
with_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    CASE year
      WHEN 2018 THEN DATE '2018-06-15'
      WHEN 2019 THEN DATE '2019-06-15'
      WHEN 2020 THEN DATE '2020-06-15'
    END as june_15,
    TRY_CAST(CAST(year AS VARCHAR) || '-' || LPAD(CAST(month_num AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '-' || LPAD(CAST(day AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') AS DATE) as week_date_parsed
  FROM weekly_totals
  WHERE year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
),
before_ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    'before' as period,
    week_date_parsed,
    total_sales,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY week_date_parsed DESC) as rn
  FROM with_dates
  WHERE week_date_parsed < june_15
),
after_ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    'after' as period,
    week_date_parsed,
    total_sales,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY week_date_parsed ASC) as rn
  FROM with_dates
  WHERE week_date_parsed > june_15
),
selected AS (
  SELECT year, period, week_date_parsed, total_sales
  FROM before_ranked WHERE rn <= 4
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, period, week_date_parsed, total_sales
  FROM after_ranked WHERE rn <= 4
),
period_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    period,
    SUM(total_sales) as period_sales
  FROM selected
  GROUP BY year, period
)
SELECT 
  b.year,
  b.period_sales as before_sales,
  a.period_sales as after_sales,
  ROUND(1.0 * (a.period_sales - b.period_sales) / b.period_sales * 100, 2) as pct_change
FROM period_totals b
JOIN period_totals a ON b.year = a.year AND b.period = 'before' AND a.period = 'after'
ORDER BY b.year
